name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-014 - Extracción documental de oportunidades SECOP II

parameters.query:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $1::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'all'
        ) AS processing_mode,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    $2::INTEGER,
                    5
                ),
                1
            ),
            5
        ) AS batch_size
),

candidates AS (
    SELECT
        document.id,

        route.processing_route,

        CASE route.processing_route
            WHEN 'office_conversion'
                THEN 0

            WHEN 'pdf_text'
                THEN 1

            WHEN 'ocr'
                THEN 2

            ELSE 9
        END AS route_priority

    FROM saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    JOIN saas.organizations
        AS organization
        ON organization.id =
           document.organization_id

    CROSS JOIN parameters

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN LOWER(
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(
                            document.downloaded_file_extension,
                            ''
                        ),
                        document.source_file_extension
                    )
                ) IN (
                    'doc',
                    'docx'
                )

                AND document.extraction_status IN (
                    'unsupported',
                    'failed'
                )

                AND COALESCE(
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'requires_conversion',
                    'false'
                ) =
                    'true'

                AND COALESCE(
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'conversion_status',
                    'pending'
                ) IN (
                    'pending',
                    'failed'
                )

                    THEN 'office_conversion'


                WHEN LOWER(
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(
                            document.downloaded_file_extension,
                            ''
                        ),
                        document.source_file_extension
                    )
                ) =
                    'pdf'

                AND document.extraction_status =
                    'pending'

                    THEN 'pdf_text'


                WHEN LOWER(
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(
                            document.downloaded_file_extension,
                            ''
                        ),
                        document.source_file_extension
                    )
                ) =
                    'pdf'

                AND document.extraction_status =
                    'failed'

                AND COALESCE(
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'requires_ocr',
                    'false'
                ) =
                    'true'

                AND COALESCE(
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'ocr_status',
                    'pending'
                ) IN (
                    'pending',
                    'failed'
                )

                    THEN 'ocr'

                ELSE NULL
            END AS processing_route
    ) AS route

    WHERE organization.status IN (
        'active',
        'trial'
    )

      AND document.download_status =
          'downloaded'

      AND document.extraction_attempt_count <
          3

      AND route.processing_route
          IS NOT NULL

      AND (
          parameters.processing_mode =
              'all'

          OR (
              parameters.processing_mode =
                  'office_only'

              AND route.processing_route =
                  'office_conversion'
          )

          OR (
              parameters.processing_mode =
                  'pdf_only'

              AND route.processing_route =
                  'pdf_text'
          )

          OR (
              parameters.processing_mode =
                  'ocr_only'

              AND route.processing_route =
                  'ocr'
          )
      )

    ORDER BY
        route_priority,
        document.updated_at ASC,
        document.id ASC

    FOR UPDATE OF document
    SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM parameters
    )
),

claimed AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    SET
        extraction_status =
            'running',

        extraction_attempt_count =
            document.extraction_attempt_count + 1,

        last_extraction_attempt_at =
            NOW(),

        extraction_error =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                document.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'active_extraction_route',
                candidate.processing_route,

                'active_extraction_started_at',
                NOW(),

                'active_extraction_execution_id',
                $3::TEXT
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM candidates
        AS candidate

    WHERE document.id =
        candidate.id

    RETURNING
        document.id
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        document.organization_id,
        document.opportunity_analysis_id,

        document.process_id,
        document.process_document_id,

        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name,

        LOWER(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    document.downloaded_file_extension,
                    ''
                ),
                NULLIF(
                    document.source_file_extension,
                    ''
                ),
                ''
            )
        ) AS file_extension,

        document.source_download_url,

        document.primary_category,
        document.detected_categories,

        document.download_sha256,
        document.extraction_attempt_count,

        candidate.processing_route,

        document.metadata
)

SELECT *
FROM claimed

ORDER BY
    CASE processing_route
        WHEN 'office_conversion'
            THEN 0

        WHEN 'pdf_text'
            THEN 1

        WHEN 'ocr'
            THEN 2

        ELSE 9
    END,

    process_reference,
    document_name;

nodes.name: Procesar extracciones una a una WF-014

parameters.query:
WITH extraction_saved AS (
    INSERT INTO saas.opportunity_document_extractions (
        opportunity_document_id,
        extraction_version,

        extractor,
        extraction_status,

        text_content,
        text_sha256,

        character_count,
        page_count,

        structured_content,
        metadata,

        created_at,
        updated_at
    )

    VALUES (
        $1::UUID,
        1,

        $2::TEXT,
        'extracted',

        $3::TEXT,

        ENCODE(
            DIGEST(
                $3::TEXT,
                'sha256'
            ),
            'hex'
        ),

        LENGTH(
            $3::TEXT
        ),

        $4::INTEGER,

        '{}'::JSONB,

        COALESCE(
            $7::JSONB,
            '{}'::JSONB
        ),

        NOW(),
        NOW()
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        opportunity_document_id,
        extraction_version
    )

    DO UPDATE SET
        extractor =
            EXCLUDED.extractor,

        extraction_status =
            'extracted',

        text_content =
            EXCLUDED.text_content,

        text_sha256 =
            EXCLUDED.text_sha256,

        character_count =
            EXCLUDED.character_count,

        page_count =
            EXCLUDED.page_count,

        extraction_error =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                saas.opportunity_document_extractions.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    RETURNING
        id
            AS extraction_id,

        opportunity_document_id,

        character_count,
        page_count,
        text_sha256
),

document_updated AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    SET
        extraction_status =
            'extracted',

        extracted_at =
            NOW(),

        extraction_error =
            NULL,

        ai_requirement_status =
            'queued',

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                document.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )

            || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_extraction_route',
                $5::TEXT,

                'last_extractor',
                $2::TEXT,

                'last_extraction_workflow',
                'WF-014',

                'last_extraction_execution_id',
                $6::TEXT,

                'last_extraction_completed_at',
                NOW()
            )

            || CASE
                WHEN $5::TEXT =
                    'office_conversion'

                    THEN jsonb_build_object(
                        'requires_conversion',
                        FALSE,

                        'conversion_status',
                        'success',

                        'conversion_completed_at',
                        NOW(),

                        'converted_format',
                        'pdf'
                    )

                WHEN $5::TEXT =
                    'ocr'

                    THEN jsonb_build_object(
                        'requires_ocr',
                        FALSE,

                        'ocr_status',
                        'success',

                        'ocr_completed_at',
                        NOW()
                    )

                ELSE
                    '{}'::JSONB
            END,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE document.id =
        $1::UUID

    RETURNING
        document.id,
        document.organization_id,
        document.opportunity_analysis_id,
        document.process_id,

        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name,
        document.primary_category,

        document.extraction_status,
        document.ai_requirement_status,

        document.metadata
)

SELECT
    document_updated.*,

    extraction_saved.extraction_id,
    extraction_saved.character_count,
    extraction_saved.page_count,
    extraction_saved.text_sha256,

    $5::TEXT
        AS processing_route

FROM document_updated

JOIN extraction_saved
    ON extraction_saved.opportunity_document_id =
       document_updated.id;

parameters.query:
UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
SET
    extraction_status =
        'failed',

    extraction_error =
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $2::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'No fue posible extraer texto útil del archivo.'
        ),

    ai_requirement_status =
        'not_requested',

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'requires_ocr',
            TRUE,

            'extraction_route',
            'ocr',

            'ocr_status',
            'pending',

            'ocr_reason',
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $2::TEXT,
                    ''
                ),
                'El extractor convencional no produjo texto.'
            ),

            'ocr_requested_at',
            NOW(),

            'last_extraction_workflow',
            'WF-014',

            'last_extraction_execution_id',
            $3::TEXT
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

WHERE id =
    $1::UUID

RETURNING
    id
        AS opportunity_document_id,

    organization_id,
    opportunity_analysis_id,
    process_id,

    process_reference,
    document_name,

    extraction_status,
    extraction_attempt_count,
    extraction_error,

    metadata
        ->> 'requires_ocr'
        AS requires_ocr,

    metadata
        ->> 'ocr_status'
        AS ocr_status,

    ai_requirement_status,

    'extraction_failed_requires_ocr'
        AS extraction_result_type,

    updated_at;

UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
SET
    extraction_status =
        'unsupported',

    extraction_error =
        CONCAT(
            'Formato pendiente de extractor especializado: ',
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    LOWER(
                        $2::TEXT
                    ),
                    ''
                ),
                'desconocido'
            )
        ),

    ai_requirement_status =
        'not_requested',

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'requires_conversion',
            TRUE,

            'conversion_status',
            'pending',

            'source_format',
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    LOWER(
                        $2::TEXT
                    ),
                    ''
                ),
                'unknown'
            ),

            'conversion_requested_at',
            NOW(),

            'last_extraction_workflow',
            'WF-014',

            'last_extraction_execution_id',
            $3::TEXT
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

WHERE id =
    $1::UUID

RETURNING
    id
        AS opportunity_document_id,

    organization_id,
    opportunity_analysis_id,
    process_id,

    process_reference,
    document_name,

    source_file_extension,
    downloaded_file_extension,

    extraction_status,
    extraction_attempt_count,
    extraction_error,

    metadata
        ->> 'requires_conversion'
        AS requires_conversion,

    metadata
        ->> 'conversion_status'
        AS conversion_status,

    ai_requirement_status,

    'unsupported_format'
        AS extraction_result_type,

    updated_at;

SELECT
    organization.name
        AS organization_name,

    document.process_reference,

    COUNT(*)
        AS total_documents,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.extraction_status =
            'pending'
    ) AS pending,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.extraction_status =
            'running'
    ) AS running,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.extraction_status =
            'extracted'
    ) AS extracted,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.extraction_status =
            'failed'
    ) AS failed,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.extraction_status =
            'unsupported'
    ) AS unsupported,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.ai_requirement_status =
            'queued'
    ) AS queued_for_ai

FROM saas.opportunity_documents
    AS document

JOIN saas.organizations AS organization
    ON organization.id =
       document.organization_id

WHERE document.download_status =
    'downloaded'

GROUP BY
    organization.name,
    document.process_reference

ORDER BY
    organization.name,
    document.process_reference;

UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
SET
    extraction_status =
        'failed',

    extraction_error =
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $2::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'El proceso OCR no produjo texto útil.'
        ),

    ai_requirement_status =
        'not_requested',

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'requires_ocr',
            TRUE,

            'ocr_status',
            'failed',

            'ocr_error',
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $2::TEXT,
                    ''
                ),
                'Error desconocido de OCR.'
            ),

            'ocr_failed_at',
            NOW(),

            'last_extraction_execution_id',
            $3::TEXT
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

WHERE id =
    $1::UUID

RETURNING
    id
        AS opportunity_document_id,

    process_reference,
    document_name,

    extraction_status,
    extraction_error,

    metadata
        ->> 'requires_ocr'
        AS requires_ocr,

    metadata
        ->> 'ocr_status'
        AS ocr_status,

    extraction_attempt_count,
    updated_at;

UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
SET
    extraction_status =
        'failed',

    extraction_error =
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $2::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'No fue posible convertir o extraer el documento Office.'
        ),

    ai_requirement_status =
        'not_requested',

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'requires_conversion',
            TRUE,

            'conversion_status',
            'failed',

            'conversion_error',
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $2::TEXT,
                    ''
                ),
                'Error desconocido de conversión Office.'
            ),

            'conversion_failed_at',
            NOW(),

            'last_extraction_execution_id',
            $3::TEXT
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

WHERE id =
    $1::UUID

RETURNING
    id
        AS opportunity_document_id,

    process_reference,
    document_name,

    extraction_status,
    extraction_error,

    metadata
        ->> 'conversion_status'
        AS conversion_status,

    updated_at;

WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            $1::TEXT,
            ''
        ) AS execution_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $2::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'all'
        ) AS processing_mode,

        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $3::TEXT,
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                5
            ),
            1
        ) AS max_documents
),

lock_acquired AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'running',

        active_execution_id =
            parameters.execution_id,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NOW(),

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW() + INTERVAL '60 minutes',

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'active_workflow',
                'WF-014',

                'active_execution_id',
                parameters.execution_id,

                'active_mode',
                parameters.processing_mode,

                'active_max_documents',
                parameters.max_documents,

                'lock_updated_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM parameters

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION'

      AND (
          cursor.status IS DISTINCT FROM
              'running'

          OR cursor.lock_expires_at IS NULL

          OR cursor.lock_expires_at <
             NOW()

          OR cursor.active_execution_id =
             parameters.execution_id
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at
),

current_state AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at

    FROM ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION'

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM lock_acquired
    ) AS lock_acquired,

    current_state.source_code,

    current_state.status,

    current_state.active_execution_id,

    current_state.lock_acquired_at,

    current_state.lock_expires_at,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM lock_acquired
        )
            THEN 'lock_acquired'

        ELSE 'execution_skipped_lock_busy'
    END AS lock_result

FROM current_state;

WITH active_lock AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at

    FROM ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION'

    LIMIT 1
),

stale_documents AS (
    SELECT
        document.id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                document.metadata
                    ->> 'active_extraction_route',
                ''
            ),

            CASE
                WHEN LOWER(
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(
                            document.downloaded_file_extension,
                            ''
                        ),
                        document.source_file_extension,
                        ''
                    )
                ) IN (
                    'doc',
                    'docx'
                )
                    THEN 'office_conversion'

                WHEN LOWER(
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(
                            document.downloaded_file_extension,
                            ''
                        ),
                        document.source_file_extension,
                        ''
                    )
                ) =
                    'pdf'

                 AND COALESCE(
                     document.metadata
                         ->> 'requires_ocr',
                     'false'
                 ) =
                     'true'
                    THEN 'ocr'

                WHEN LOWER(
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(
                            document.downloaded_file_extension,
                            ''
                        ),
                        document.source_file_extension,
                        ''
                    )
                ) =
                    'pdf'
                    THEN 'pdf_text'

                ELSE 'unknown'
            END
        ) AS recovery_route,

        NULLIF(
            document.metadata
                ->> 'active_extraction_execution_id',
            ''
        ) AS document_execution_id

    FROM saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    WHERE document.extraction_status =
          'running'

      AND COALESCE(
          document.last_extraction_attempt_at,
          document.updated_at,
          document.created_at
      ) <
          NOW() - INTERVAL '45 minutes'

      /*
       * No recuperar documentos que todavía pertenecen
       * a una ejecución activa con bloqueo vigente.
       */
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1

          FROM active_lock
              AS lock

          WHERE lock.status =
                'running'

            AND lock.lock_expires_at >
                NOW()

            AND lock.active_execution_id
                IS NOT NULL

            AND lock.active_execution_id =
                COALESCE(
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'active_extraction_execution_id',
                    ''
                )
      )

    FOR UPDATE OF document
    SKIP LOCKED
),

recovered AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    SET
        extraction_status =
            CASE stale.recovery_route
                WHEN 'pdf_text'
                    THEN 'pending'

                WHEN 'office_conversion'
                    THEN 'failed'

                WHEN 'ocr'
                    THEN 'failed'

                ELSE 'failed'
            END,

        /*
         * Una interrupción del workflow no debe consumir
         * permanentemente un intento de extracción.
         */
        extraction_attempt_count =
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    document.extraction_attempt_count,
                    0
                ) - 1,
                0
            ),

        last_extraction_attempt_at =
            NULL,

        extraction_error =
            CASE stale.recovery_route
                WHEN 'pdf_text'
                    THEN
                        'Extracción PDF convencional recuperada después de quedar bloqueada en running.'

                WHEN 'office_conversion'
                    THEN
                        'Conversión Office recuperada después de quedar bloqueada en running.'

                WHEN 'ocr'
                    THEN
                        'Proceso OCR recuperado después de quedar bloqueado en running.'

                ELSE
                    'Extracción recuperada automáticamente después de quedar bloqueada en running.'
            END,

        ai_requirement_status =
            'not_requested',

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    document.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_extraction_route'
                - 'active_extraction_started_at'
                - 'active_extraction_execution_id'
            )

            || CASE stale.recovery_route
                WHEN 'office_conversion'
                    THEN jsonb_build_object(
                        'requires_conversion',
                        TRUE,

                        'conversion_status',
                        'pending',

                        'conversion_requeued_at',
                        NOW()
                    )

                WHEN 'ocr'
                    THEN jsonb_build_object(
                        'requires_ocr',
                        TRUE,

                        'ocr_status',
                        'pending',

                        'ocr_requeued_at',
                        NOW()
                    )

                WHEN 'pdf_text'
                    THEN jsonb_build_object(
                        'pdf_text_status',
                        'pending',

                        'pdf_text_requeued_at',
                        NOW()
                    )

                ELSE
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'recovery_requires_manual_review',
                        TRUE
                    )
            END

            || jsonb_build_object(
                'automatic_recovery_at',
                NOW(),

                'automatic_recovery_workflow',
                'WF-014',

                'automatic_recovery_route',
                stale.recovery_route,

                'recovered_execution_id',
                stale.document_execution_id,

                'automatic_recovery_reason',
                'Documento abandonado en running sin una ejecución activa propietaria.'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM stale_documents
        AS stale

    WHERE document.id =
          stale.id

    RETURNING
        document.id,
        document.organization_id,
        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name,
        document.extraction_status,
        document.extraction_attempt_count,
        document.updated_at
)

SELECT
    COUNT(*)
        AS recovered_documents,

    COALESCE(
        JSONB_AGG(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'opportunity_document_id',
                recovered.id,

                'organization_id',
                recovered.organization_id,

                'process_reference',
                recovered.process_reference,

                'document_name',
                recovered.document_name,

                'recovery_route',
                stale.recovery_route,

                'previous_execution_id',
                stale.document_execution_id,

                'new_extraction_status',
                recovered.extraction_status,

                'extraction_attempt_count',
                recovered.extraction_attempt_count,

                'recovered_at',
                recovered.updated_at
            )
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE recovered.id IS NOT NULL
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS recovered_items,

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
            THEN 'no_stale_documents'

        ELSE 'stale_documents_recovered'
    END AS recovery_status

FROM recovered

JOIN stale_documents
    AS stale
    ON stale.id =
       recovered.id;

WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            $1::TEXT,
            ''
        ) AS execution_id
),

released AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_successful_workflow',
                'WF-014',

                'last_successful_execution_id',
                parameters.execution_id,

                'last_successful_finished_at',
                NOW(),

                'lock_released_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM parameters

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id =
          parameters.execution_id

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at
),

current_state AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at

    FROM ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION'

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_released,

    released.source_code,
    released.status,
    released.active_execution_id,
    released.lock_acquired_at,
    released.lock_expires_at,
    released.error_message,
    released.updated_at,

    'lock_released'
        AS release_result

FROM released

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_released,

    current_state.source_code,
    current_state.status,
    current_state.active_execution_id,
    current_state.lock_acquired_at,
    current_state.lock_expires_at,
    current_state.error_message,
    current_state.updated_at,

    CASE
        WHEN current_state.active_execution_id
             IS NULL

         AND current_state.status IN (
             'idle',
             'success'
         )
            THEN 'already_released'

        ELSE 'lock_owned_by_another_execution'
    END AS release_result

FROM current_state

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM released
);
